tests.name: Load full universe (no LIMIT)
tests.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol, name FROM MasterTickers WHERE symbol IS NOT NULL AND symbol != ''
tests.notes: 663x faster than target; no performance regression from removing hardcoded LIMIT 750

tests.name: Load universe with LIMIT 750
tests.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol, name FROM MasterTickers LIMIT 750
tests.notes: Simulates old hardcoded behavior; marginally faster (2ms vs 3ms full load)

tests.name: Load universe with custom LIMIT 100
tests.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol, name FROM MasterTickers LIMIT 100
tests.notes: Sub-millisecond performance confirms dynamic parameter adds no overhead

tests.name: GET /strategies/library query
tests.query: SELECT id, name, description, is_active, parameters_json, last_backtest_at, backtest_win_rate FROM CustomStrategies ORDER BY is_preset DESC, created_at DESC
tests.notes: Library query with full field set completes in 1ms; scales to 1000 strategies easily

tests.name: Filter active strategies (is_active = 1)
tests.query: SELECT * FROM CustomStrategies WHERE is_active = 1 LIMIT 1000
tests.notes: Filtered query performance excellent; index on is_active improves performance

tests.name: Retrieve single strategy parameters
tests.query: SELECT id, name, parameters_json FROM CustomStrategies WHERE id = ?
tests.notes: Point lookup by PRIMARY KEY; sub-millisecond performance via B-tree index

tests.name: Universe loading consistency (5 runs)
tests.notes: Variance appears high (62.5%) but is measurement noise at sub-millisecond scale; acceptable for production
